# HFT Indicator Analysis — 4H Chart (BTC)

## Latest Readings (most recent candle, Close = 26,021.96)

| Indicator | Latest Value | Signal |
|-----------|-------------|--------|
| **RSI (14)** | 44.77 | Neutral / mild bearish (rising) |
| **MACD** | -68.19 (signal -77.12, hist +8.93) | Bullish crossover but deeply sub-zero |
| **ROC (10)** | -0.29 | Flat / neutral |
| **Stoch %K / %D** | 42.96 / 39.27 | Bullish crossover, recovering from oversold |
| **Williams %R** | -54.4 | Neutral, rising off oversold |

## Interpretation

**Price context:** A sharp collapse from ~29,400 (Aug 10–14) to a low near 25,166 (Aug 17), followed by a ~1 week base-building consolidation in the **25,950–26,200** zone. Price is coiling tight — a breakout setup is building.

**Momentum — recovering but unconfirmed:**
- **MACD histogram** has been positive for ~9 candles (+8.9) and the MACD line sits above its signal — a constructive, early bullish crossover. But the MACD line remains **deeply negative (-68)**, so this is a *base-recovery*, not a confirmed uptrend.
- **Stochastic %K (42.96) crossed above %D (39.27)** and is climbing steadily from ~20 (oversold) — momentum turning up.
- **Williams %R (-54.4)** rebounded from -85 toward mid-range, confirming the oversold unwinding.

**RSI (44.77)** sits just below the 50 midline — recovery intact but buyers have not seized control.

## Trade Bias: **Neutral-to-Cautiously-Bullish (range/reversal watch)**

- **Long trigger:** A 4H close above ~26,220 (recent resistance cluster) with expanding volume and RSI reclaiming 50 confirms the base breakout; targets 26,400 → 26,800.
- **Short risk:** Failure at 26,220 and a break back under ~25,900 (range floor / near-term lows) re-engages the downtrend; targets 25,500 → 25,166.
- **Caution:** ROC is essentially flat (-0.29) and MACD remains underwater — no strong directional conviction yet. Momentum is favoring the bulls via Stoch/MACD-hist, but the larger trend is still damaged. Treat as a **range trade with tight stops** until a clean breakout.

**Bias:** Buy the dip within range on Stoch/MACD support; stand aside on a range break; favor upside only above 26,220, downside below 25,900.
